text: Even with the most decided inclination to look at War from the highest point of view, it would be very wrong to look down upon this corporate spirit (esprit de corps) which may and should exist more or less in every Army. This corporate spirit forms the bond of union between the natural forces which are active in that which we have called military virtue.
author: Carl von Clausewitz
locator: Book III, Chapter V, Military Virtue of an Army
